# The cargo-shaped children one `tools/verify.sh --fast` run spawns over
# gate_contract's FakeRepo (workspace scope, macOS, gui smoke skipped by the
# fixture), one per line, sorted: `<driver> <VAR>=<value>... -- <argv...>`.
# Read by `the_fast_ladder_spawns_exactly_the_recorded_cargo_invocations`.
#
# DERIVED 2026-09-13 FROM THE REAL OLD GATE, not written by hand: the same
# recording shim was run against the 18f19eea6 aterm-verify, which spawned 22
# lines (20 targo, 2 targo-tippy). This file is that multiset with exactly:
#   * the lane columns of the stages that moved lane (target_design
#     lanes_and_target_dirs): the regex lane -> <root>/target-regex and
#     CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4; every xtask verb -> <root>/target-xtask, 4; the
#     smoke, redraw and eight objc builds -> <root>/target-drivers, 8; the L0
#     gate -> its explicit <root>/tools/freeze-safety-gate/target. Argv,
#     RUSTDOC and ATERM_SEARCH_REGEX_LANE are unchanged on every one of them.
#   * exception 1: `test --workspace --no-fail-fast` -> the same with
#     `--no-run`, and the same with `--tests`.
#   * exception 2: the driver builds row's three children (the redraw build,
#     the smoke build, and the eight objc examples in one invocation).
#   * exception 3 (2026-09-14): the sealed fabric rung's two children, in the
#     driver lane (<root>/target-drivers, 8) — its suite drives the aterm-gui
#     it finds in the dir it was compiled into, so it first runs the smokes'
#     `build -q -p aterm-gui -p aterm-ctl` there (a third copy of that line),
#     then `test -p aterm-link --features sealed --test two_nodes_sealed`.
#   * exception 4 (2026-09-16): the atpkg publish tooling's build child, in the
#     same lane — `build -q -p atpkg`, the binary its end-to-end pack suite
#     drives through $ATPKG. Until then the row was Lane::Pure at t0 and drove
#     whatever `<root>/target/debug/atpkg` a PREVIOUS run had left.
#   * exception 5 (2026-09-17): `gate citations` joined the xtask lane. It is a
#     directory walk over the release + packaging surface, so it costs a second
#     and rides the merge contract rather than living only in `gate all`, which
#     nothing automatic invokes (crates/xtask/src/gate.rs' header says so).
#   * exception 6 (2026-09-22): the conformance-release prime — `build
#     --locked --release -p aterm` into `<root>/target/conformance-release`,
#     6 jobs. It is not a new build: it is the build
#     `crates/aterm-conformance/tests/support/mod.rs`'s `release_bin` already
#     ran INSIDE the test stage, for the paint, spin and untracked-staging
#     suites that judge the RELEASE binary, moved to t0 in a lane of its own.
# `<inherited>` means the child got the test process's own value.
targo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<inherited> CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=<inherited> RUSTDOC=<inherited> ATERM_SEARCH_REGEX_LANE=<inherited> -- --unverified build --workspace
targo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<inherited> CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=<inherited> RUSTDOC=<stage2>/trustdoc ATERM_SEARCH_REGEX_LANE=<inherited> -- --unverified test --doc --workspace --no-fail-fast
targo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<inherited> CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=<inherited> RUSTDOC=<stage2>/trustdoc ATERM_SEARCH_REGEX_LANE=<inherited> -- --unverified test --workspace --no-fail-fast --no-run
targo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<inherited> CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=<inherited> RUSTDOC=<stage2>/trustdoc ATERM_SEARCH_REGEX_LANE=<inherited> -- --unverified test --workspace --no-fail-fast --tests
targo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<root>/target-drivers CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 RUSTDOC=<inherited> ATERM_SEARCH_REGEX_LANE=<inherited> -- --unverified build -q -p aterm-gui --example objc_alert_drive

targo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<root>/target-xtask CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 RUSTDOC=<inherited> ATERM_SEARCH_REGEX_LANE=<inherited> -- --unverified run -q -p xtask -- gate citations
targo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<root>/target-xtask CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 RUSTDOC=<inherited> ATERM_SEARCH_REGEX_LANE=<inherited> -- --unverified run -q -p xtask -- gate counts

targo-tippy CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<root>/target-tippy CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=<inherited> RUSTDOC=<inherited> ATERM_SEARCH_REGEX_LANE=<inherited> -- -p aterm-gui -p aterm-scrollback --features aterm-gui/bench-support,aterm-gui/control-conformance,aterm-scrollback/disk-tier --all-targets --keep-going -- -D warnings
